g.text: RAILWAY LEVEL CROSSING & TRAIN TRAFFIC CONTROLLER
PRECISION RTL BLOCK DIAGRAM & COMPONENT-LEVEL ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT SCHEMATIC (WITH EXACT VALUES)
PART A: RTL HARDWARE ARCHITECTURE & DIGITAL SUBSYSTEM BLOCK DIAGRAM (WITH BUS WIDTHS & TIMING CONSTANTS)
• Built exclusively with: and, or, not, buf
✔ Blocks manual gate lift when train is on track
✔ Trips alarm if gate opens while track busy
PART B: PHYSICAL COMPONENT-LEVEL ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT SCHEMATIC (WITH EXACT RESISTOR, CAPACITOR & VOLTAGE VALUES)
Arduino Uno R3 (ATmega328P @ 16 MHz) / Basys 3 FPGA
• IR Transmitter: GaAs LED (λ = 940 nm), I_F = 20 mA, R_limit = 220 Ω, 1/4W
• IR Receiver: Phototransistor with R_pullup = 10 kΩ to +5V
• Reference Voltage: 10 kΩ Multi-turn Preset Potentiometer (V_ref = 2.5 V typ)
• Comparator IC: LM393 Dual Differential Voltage Comparator (Open Collector)
• Indicator: 3mm Green LED with 1 kΩ Series Resistor on D0 Output
VCC → +5V | GND → Common GND | OUT → Pin D2 (Active LOW 0V when train present)
VCC → +5V | GND → Common GND | OUT → Pin D3 (Direct gate interlock trigger)
VCC → +5V | GND → Common GND | OUT → Pin D7 (Starts 5.0s clear buffer)
VCC → +5V | GND → Common GND | OUT → Pin A1 (Instant emergency halt)
GATE BARRIER ACTUATORS (TOWERPRO SG90 SERVOS x2)
• Operating Voltage: 4.8 V to 6.0 V DC (Powered by Dedicated External 5V 2A Rail)
• Peak Stall Current: 650 mA to 800 mA each (Total Peak Demand = 1.6 A)
• Control Signal: 50 Hz PWM (Period T = 20.0 ms, Logic High = 3.3V / 5.0V TTL)
• Pulse Width for 90° (Vertical Barrier Open): 1.50 ms to 2.00 ms
• Pulse Width for 0° (Horizontal Barrier Closed): 1.00 ms
Orange (PWM) → Pin D9 | Red (VCC) → Ext +5V | Brown (GND) → Common GND
Orange (PWM) → Pin D10 | Red (VCC) → Ext +5V | Brown (GND) → Common GND
LIGHT SIGNALS, AUDIBLE ALARM & MANUAL EMERGENCY
A. ROAD TRAFFIC LIGHT HEAD (Current-Limited 15 mA):
RED LED (Stop): Pin D4 in series with R1 = 220 Ω ±5%, 1/4W (Cathode → GND)
YELLOW LED (Warn): Pin D5 in series with R2 = 220 Ω ±5%, 1/4W (Cathode → GND)
GREEN LED (Go): Pin D6 in series with R3 = 220 Ω ±5%, 1/4W (Cathode → GND)
B. CROSSBUCK RED WIG-WAG FLASHERS (x4 LEDs, 1.25 Hz):
• Left Red Pair: Pin D12 in series with R4 = 220 Ω ±5%, 1/4W
• Right Red Pair: Pin D13 in series with R5 = 220 Ω ±5%, 1/4W
GREEN Aspect (Track Clear): Pin A2 + R6 = 220 Ω (Active ONLY Gate=0°)
RED Aspect (Stop Train): Pin A3 + R7 = 220 Ω (Gate Open / Obstacle)
D. ACTIVE PIEZO BUZZER TRANSDUCER (5V, 85 dB @ 10cm):
• Positive (+) Lead: Connected to Pin D8 (PWM tone generation)
• Negative (-) Lead: Connected to Common Ground (GND)
Tone: 1.8 kHz pulsed chime during gate descent; 2.8 kHz continuous siren on hazard
E. MANUAL EMERGENCY STOP PUSH BUTTON (SPST NO):
• Switch Terminal 1: Connected to +5V Logic Rail
• Switch Terminal 2: Connected to Pin A0 AND 10 kΩ Pull-Down Resistor to GND
Guarantees 0.0V logic LOW quiescent state; instantaneous 5.0V pulse on emergency
⚡ DUAL POWER RAILS (PROTECTS MCU FROM SERVO INDUCTIVE SPIKES):
• Logic Rail (5.0V @ 200mA): Powered from USB or 7805 regulator for MCU & LM393.
• Motor Rail (5.0V @ 2.0A): Dedicated external DC adapter exclusively for SG90 servos.
• Decoupling Filter: C1 = 470 μF / 16V Electrolytic ∥ C2 = 0.1 μF / 50V Ceramic
Connected across Servo +5V to GND to suppress transient voltage droops.
★ COMMON GROUND MANDATE: All GND terminals MUST be bonded into a common rail.
